items.title: Australia divided over how to tackle illegal tobacco crisis
items.description: After decades as a world leader in tobacco control, Australia now finds itself in troubled waters. But those trying to find solutions are far from on the same page.

items.title: Tupac was a 'global megastar', then his murder created an enduring mystery
items.description: Three decades after the murder of rapper Tupac Shakur, the world may get some answers about who killed the young superstar — and why.

items.title: High interest rates here to stay, but only one part of house price story
items.description: We seem to have flipped from worrying about rising house prices to worrying about falling house prices. Well, some of us have, anyway.

items.title: Israeli government rejects Trump's Gaza peace plan
items.description: Israeli Prime Minster Benjamin Netanyahu says Hamas's proposed plan for disarming is "unacceptable", rejecting the Trump administration's plans to end fighting in the Palestinian territory.

items.title: Albanese is the opposite of Rudd and that comes with its own risks
items.description: Cabinet's indecision on support for Tony Burke's immigration cuts shows a key difference between Anthony Albanese and Kevin Rudd.

items.title: AI assistant hacks into website trying to book a gym class
items.description: When Andrew asked his AI personal assistant to book him a spot in a gym class, he had no idea he would accidentally initiate an autonomous cyber-attack.

items.title: Millions of Australians will have no say in who inherits their super
items.description: New research shows most Australians have not made a legally binding death benefit nomination to ensure their superannuation goes to who they want it to when they die. And many funds do not make it easy.

items.title: Paramilitary promises footage of supreme leader unseen since March
items.description: Video of Iran's supreme leader Mojtaba Khamenei who has not been seen in public since he assumed the role in March, has been promised by a paramilitary leader.

items.title: Volodymyr Zelenskyy says 50,000 North Korean troops will help Russia in war
items.description: The Ukrainian president took to social media to announced "a decision has been made for 30,000 to 50,000 North Koreans to be deployed on the territory of Russia", while calling on South Korea to provide support for Ukraine's air defence.

items.title: Body found in suitcase in southern NSW
items.description: The body of a person, believed to be female, has been found in a suitcase at Oallen, about 60 kilometres south-east of Goulburn.

items.title: President Trump Announces U.S. Military Airstrike in Venezuela
items.description: President Trump states the U.S. military conducted its first known airstrike inside Venezuela targeting a dock where drugs were allegedly loaded onto boats[1][2][4].

items.title: Trump Meets Netanyahu at Mar-a-Lago for Gaza Ceasefire Phase Two Talks
items.description: President Trump met with Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu to discuss advancing phase two of the Gaza ceasefire, including reconstruction and responses to Iran[1][4].

items.title: Feds Launch Massive Taxpayer Fraud Probe in Minnesota After Viral Video
items.description: Federal agencies including DHS, FBI, and ICE investigate $110 million in suspected fraud at Minnesota child care centers following a viral YouTube video[3].

items.title: Americans Express Widespread Opposition to AI Data Centers
items.description: Public backlash against AI infrastructure data centers grows, with protests and demands for bans influencing Democratic Party strategies for future elections[3].

items.title: Elon Musk's Humanoid Robot Vision: China Poised to Lead Production
items.description: China prioritizes humanoid robots in tech race with U.S., ramping up production while warning of industry bubble and potential bottlenecks[3].

items.title: Trump-Putin Call Amid Ukraine-Russia Tensions Over Peace Plan
items.description: President Trump spoke with Putin amid ongoing Ukraine conflict, with Russia reevaluating peace plan tenets after Ukrainian denials[1].

items.title: Democratic Gubernatorial Candidates in Wisconsin Focus on Inflation and Trump
items.description: Seven Democrats vying for Wisconsin governor blame economic issues on Trump and emphasize affordability ahead of 2026 primary[3].
